election._note: Regional-list PR in twelve counties, D'Hondt, with a 1% national threshold since the 2024 electoral-code change; reduced to national D'Hondt. Elected 11 May 2025 for four years, so the next is due by spring 2029. Electoral Code of Albania; Wikipedia, '2025 Albanian parliamentary election'.

dissolution._note: The President dissolves the Kuvendi only when it fails to elect a Prime Minister (Art. 96) or by its own two-thirds decision to dissolve (Art. 65(2)) -- the nearest template reading is confidence_failure, the self-dissolution route recorded here. Constitution of Albania, Arts. 65, 96.

head_of_state._note: The President, elected by the Kuvendi for five years (a single re-election allowed); elected June 2022 and sworn in July, so the next falls in July 2027. Ceremonial. Constitution of Albania, Arts. 86-89.
head_of_state.title: President

amendment._note: Art. 177: two thirds of all deputies; one fifth of them may ask that an approved amendment go to referendum, which then decides it. Constitution of Albania, Art. 177.
amendment._referendum_note: The referendum is triggered by a fifth of the deputies (Art. 177(4)), FRA's optional-stage shape in a parliamentary key. Constitution of Albania, Art. 177.
amendment._permits_system_change_note: No eternity clause; the 1998 constitution itself was adopted by referendum and has been amended by the Art. 177 route (2008, 2016).

judicial._note: A Constitutional Court reviews the constitutionality of laws (Arts. 124-134), rebuilt after the 2016 justice-reform vetting. Constitution of Albania, Art. 131.

formation._note: The President nominates the Prime Minister from the majority and the Kuvendi approves him by a majority of all deputies (Art. 96). No-confidence is CONSTRUCTIVE: a motion carries only by electing a successor with a majority of all members (Art. 105) -- the template's constructive_absolute reads it exactly. Constitution of Albania, Arts. 96, 105.

government._pretender_note: Whom data/laws/amendments.json's Restoration Act puts on the throne. Albania was a kingdom from 1928 to 1939; the restored monarch here is fictional.

fiscal._note: General government, IMF/Ministry of Finance ~2024, rounded, on AUT.json's conventions. VAT 20% standard; corporate 15%; income 13 is the middle band of the 0/13/23 wage schedule; capital gains 15%; no wealth tax. Revenue ~27% of GDP includes social contributions. Debt ~56% of GDP (end-2024). Spending scaled to expenditure near 30% of GDP; defence 1.8% on the path to NATO's 2%.
